executionMode.description: D-022's three levels of graph-mutation autonomy, and nothing else. autopilot accepts the Governor's own proposed mutations automatically. supervised holds a proposal until the owner approves it - something is queued, waiting. manual rejects every proposal outright - nothing is queued, nothing waits; the owner changes the graph by other means. An absent mode (reachable only on a stream with no executionStarted yet folded) reads identically to manual - both reject outright. Does NOT hold dispatch - a ready node runs identically in every mode; hold dispatch with pause, not a stricter mode.

clearanceIdentityRegistered.description: An identity gains the power to countersign, from this sequence on. Runtime membership is journaled rather than spec-edited, so 'who could countersign at sequence N' is a question the journal answers by itself, without a spec edit. ORDERING NOTE, for anyone adding a kind to this vocabulary: the store validates every event against it on APPEND and on READ, so this list MAY LEAD the Rust EventKind enum and must NEVER LAG it. A name here with no Rust variant is inert - nothing can emit it, so no journal can contain it. A Rust variant with no name here emits values the store then refuses on append, with no diagnostic naming what is missing. The asymmetry is the whole rule: one direction is dead weight, the other is a silent refusal.
